payload.claim: No test checks the content of the per-reason `left out` lines `saffron chains` prints (only the break line, the final compared/break count line, and the exit code are asserted in `test_saffron_chains_prints_its_count_and_exits_0_or_2_on_a_raise`). Hard-coding the reason text so every line prints the same reason regardless of which `LeftOutReason` it actually is would keep every existing assertion green (the counts and the compared/break totals are unaffected), yet the printed breakdown — which the spec says feeds item 170's migrate-or-abandon decision — would be wrong. `ChainComparison.left_out` itself is verified correctly in the unit test, but the CLI's rendering of it is not.
